summary: Account Clarity Improvements Testing - Portal Marketing. All 11 requested features verified. One critical bug found and FIXED: ShiftsTab crash due to SelectItem empty string values. All AccountBadge, ActiveAccountBar, and filter features working correctly.

design_issues.screen: ActiveAccountBar in KOL Creator & LiveHost modules
issues: KOL Creator module and LiveHost (LiveHostsTab) use local filterAccountId state instead of useActiveMarketingAccount hook. This means changing account in KOL/LiveHost does NOT write to localStorage, so cross-module persistence is only partial. Only SalesDataEntryModule uses useActiveMarketingAccount for full localStorage persistence. The useActiveMarketingAccount hook is imported in KOLCreatorModule but not used.

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: CRITICAL BUG FIXED: SelectItem components with empty string values ('') caused React runtime error: 'A <SelectItem /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string'. The Shift Management tab crashed with Portal Error on load.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed SelectItem value='' to value='all' for 'Semua Host' and 'Semua Status' in ShiftsTab filters. Also fixed Script form's Account dropdown (Global/All Accounts) using value='global'. Updated filter params to skip 'all' values when making API calls.

✅ TEST 2: Sales Input Form dialog does NOT auto-select account - shows 'Pilih akun' placeholder
✅ TEST 3: Visual confirmation banner 'Input ke: [account name]' appears after account selection in Sales form
✅ TEST 4: ActiveAccountBar present in KOL Creator module with 'Filter creator by akun:' hint
✅ TEST 5: ActiveAccountBar present in LiveHost module with 'Filter LiveHost by akun:' hint
✅ TEST 6: Creator cards display colored AccountBadge ('🎵 Tiktok Shop - Test Live') for assigned accounts
✅ TEST 7: Filter creator by account via ActiveAccountBar works (3 creators → 3 when all assigned to TikTok)
✅ TEST 8: LiveHost table 'Assigned Accounts' column shows AccountBadge colored badges, NOT 'X account(s)' text
✅ TEST 9: Filter LiveHost by account via ActiveAccountBar works (2 hosts → 1 when filtering by TikTok)
✅ TEST 10: AddShiftModal opens without Portal Error after bug fix (Shift Management tab loads correctly)

✅ TEST 11b: AddShiftModal shows amber warning 'Host belum di-assign ke akun manapun' when host has no assigned accounts

action_items: Consider wiring KOLCreatorModule and LiveHostModule's ActiveAccountBar to use useActiveMarketingAccount hook for true cross-module localStorage persistence. Currently they use local filterAccountId state only. (The hook IS imported in KOLCreatorModule but not used.)

KOL Creator filter works but since all 3 demo creators are assigned to the same TikTok account, filtering by that account shows all 3 (100%) - consider adding diversity in seed data for more realistic filter testing.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: LiveHostModule ShiftsTab had SelectItem with value='' causing React runtime error. Fixed to use value='all'.
DESIGN GAP: KOLCreatorModule imports useActiveMarketingAccount but doesn't use it - filterAccountId is local state only. Cross-module persistence is incomplete.
LiveHostModule.jsx is 2320 lines - exceeds the 700-line limit guideline. Should be split into sub-components.
AddShiftModal correctly implements host→account filtering with warning for unassigned hosts.
KOL SessionFormModal correctly implements creator→account filtering with amber warning.
seed_data_creation: Used KOL 'Seed Demo' button to create 3 creators + 9 sessions. Assigned TikTok Shop account to 'Test LiveHost' for LiveHost AccountBadge testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AccountBadge, ActiveAccountBar, and filter features are all working. The Shifts tab crash bug (SelectItem empty value) has been fixed. The only minor gap is that KOL and LiveHost modules use local filterAccountId state for their ActiveAccountBar (not connected to useActiveMarketingAccount/localStorage hook). Only SalesDataEntryModule properly uses the localStorage hook for global persistence.
